colophon: Thus ends the Sri Hanumad Raksha Stotra.

lines.1: Bearing in his left hand the mountain that shatters his enemies, in the other a chisel that breaks chains,
lines.2: granting boons, the color of the clearest gold, with blazing earrings: I worship Anjaneya.
lines.3: His cheeks and head reddened by the glow of his ruby earrings,
lines.4: within a grove of divine golden plantains: I meditate on the son of the Wind.
lines.5: Bright as the rising sun, mighty in his generous arms,
lines.6: lovely as ten million Kamas, master of every science,
lines.7: the joy of Sri Rama's heart, a wish-fulfilling tree for his devotees,
lines.8: showing with his two hands fearlessness and the giving of boons: I contemplate the son of the Wind.
lines.9: With his left hand crushing the hands of ten-headed Ravana, the great affliction,
lines.10: with alert, upturned gaze and bow in hand: let one meditate on Hanuman.
lines.11: Clear as crystal, golden in luster, two-armed, palms joined in reverence,
lines.12: his lotus face shining between two earrings: I worship Hari, the monkey.
